stop_reason: Stopped at the +20% band ceiling: 48 facet records (band 32-48) from 102 URL seeds; 78 craft sources stored. A first fetch pass also sent the seed file's section comments as URLs (they failed ValueError); the comments were then stripped from seeds/craft.txt. Curated to 48 by dropping JS-shell SPAs (Material/Apple HIG/Fonts Knowledge), duplicates, and technique-overlapping pages, all listed in excluded_from_facet_corpus. VOCABULARY DRIFT (per r1 §3.1): added techniques live-regions (MDN Live Regions), responsive-layout (web.dev/NN-g/Every Layout), lazy-rendering (web.dev content-visibility), svg-optimization (Smashing part 4), aria (Smashing ARIA), table-semantics (W3C Tables); aesthetics used: unspecified/light-minimal/hybrid-theme/dark-dense/precision-instrument/editorial. No live-KB writes.
coverage_note: F5 is the normative/craft family. STRONG: accessibility (WCAG 2.2 Quickref + contrast SC + WAI tables/APG + MDN live regions/forced-colors + web.dev Learn Accessibility), SVG craft (MDN tutorial/paths/text/use/viewBox, four CSS-Tricks archive pieces, SVG-Tutorial, four Smashing SVG articles), motion (MDN/web.dev reduced-motion, NN/g microinteractions, spring physics), typography (Practical Typography, Smashing fintech typefaces), and token/theming systems (MDN custom properties/color-mix, design-token naming). GAP: the named Material/Apple HIG DENSITY bar is unavailable to text extraction (client-rendered SPAs return 0 chars), so the density ladder is evidenced indirectly via Every Layout, web.dev Learn Responsive Design, NN/g table density and Refactoring UI - r3/r5 must carry that caveat. Some SVG archive pieces are dated (2014-2019) but canonical and kept for that reason. No performance-measured evidence beyond web.dev content-visibility; no repo-level a11y audits, so accessibility_evidence is audited only on standards bodies.
